jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant with experience in operations and supply chain, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Do you bring a strong business background in supply chain and experience from internal or external consulting? Are you curious about working with technology, data and digital solutions? And are you motivated by helping organisations solve complex problems and create lasting, meaningful results? Then this could be a wonderful opportunity for you.

About Valcon

Valcon is a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation. With offices in the Netherlands, Denmark, the UK, Sweden, Croatia and Serbia, we bring consulting, technology and data together to help organisations turn ambition into measurable results. We welcome colleagues with different backgrounds, perspectives and ways of working who are motivated to create value together.

In this role, you will…

• Help clients improve their supply chains by solving complex challenges across planning, procurement, and operations

• Lead or contribute to transformation initiatives from analysis and solution design through implementation, creating measurable business value along the way

• Build strong relationships with clients and colleagues, bringing people together around practical solutions that improve performance, decision-making, and long-term resilience

• Use data, insights, and structured problem-solving to identify opportunities and help organizations create more efficient and future-ready supply chains

We’re looking for someone who…

• Has experience within Supply Chain, Operations, Management Consulting, or another transformation-focused role

• Brings expertise from areas such as Supply Chain Planning, S&OP, Logistics/Distribution, Procurement, Manufacturing, or Operational Excellence

• Enjoys turning complexity into clarity and can balance analytical thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach

• Can independently lead, manage and effectively drive complex transformation programs/projects

• Has experience with data, digital solutions, or technology-enabled transformation, and is curious about how innovation can create business value

• Is a strong relationship builder who can engage stakeholders across different organizational levels and drive change through collaboration

• Holds a relevant master’s degree

What we can offer

At Valcon, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and supported. Our career model provides clear roles and expectations, supported by a fair and transparent process for all. You will join an international work environment with an informal culture and a flat hierarchy that encourages both personal and professional growth. Here, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with talented colleagues across business areas and levels.

We also offer enhanced benefits and support across different life stages, including parental and adoption leave, health and wellbeing initiatives, and resources for navigating significant life transitions. Our culture is shaped by our core values — Integrity, Together, Joy, Curious and Can Do — which guide how we work and grow together. We regularly come together for social events and activities such as yoga, wine tasting, knitting nights, padel tennis, Friday bars and seasonal parties. Our hub, “The Hive,” is a welcoming office in the heart of Copenhagen at Meldahlsgade 5, where homemade breakfast and lunch are served every day.

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Head of Center of Excellence for Project Management
jobs.description:
At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to saving and improving lives by unlocking the power of the immune system. Our commercial portfolio includes market-leading vaccines against smallpox/mpox, rabies, tick-borne encephalitis, typhoid fever, and cholera. We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, working every day to protect people’s health and quality of life and protect our tomorrow.

We are looking for an experienced leader for the Head of Center of Excellence (project management) role in our Strategy Execution department who combines strategic thinking, strong change management capabilities, and a genuine passion for building organizational capability. In this role, you will not only define how projects are governed and delivered but also drive the adoption of new ways of working across a global organization.

**About The Role

**This is a broad and hands-on role spanning project leadership and organizational capability building within project excellence. A key aspect of the role is driving organizational change by ensuring that project management frameworks, tools, and processes are successfully adopted, understood, and embedded across the business. In this dual role, you will balance being Head of Center of Excellence while managing high-impact cross-functional projects yourself. Just as importantly, you will turn standards into practice by designing and delivering training, facilitating sessions, coaching colleagues, and creating engagement across the organization.

You will work across R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, and corporate functions. The portfolio may include merger and acquisition activities, development projects, vaccine launches, technology implementations, and other enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. Success requires someone who enjoys moving between strategic planning, practical implementation, and visible facilitation in front of an audience.

The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will join a team of +20 Project Managers, Program Leads, and Student Assistants and report to the VP of Strategy Execution Office.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously strengthen project management standards, governance, tools, templates, and ways of working across the organization

• Lead complex, cross-functional strategic projects, including initiatives connected to M&A, product development, vaccine launches, and enterprise transformation

• Drive adoption of project management methodologies and support organizational change through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and coaching

• Develop project management capability through structured training, facilitation, coaching, and hands-on knowledge sharing across different functions and seniority levels

• Serve as a visible ambassador for project excellence, translating methodology into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences

• Partner with senior stakeholders to create alignment, transparency, sound decision-making, and clear ownership throughout the project lifecycle

• Drive disciplined planning, risk management, resource coordination, and execution, supported by strong use of project and portfolio management tools

**What You Bring

**You bring extensive experience leading complex projects within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated healthcare environment. You also bring change management expertise combined with hands-on delivery experience. Besides this, we are looking for someone with the following background;

• A genuine interest in the full scope of project management excellence, from strategic framework design and governance to practical implementation and organizational training

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence and energy to stand in front of an audience, engage participants, and make complex methods practical and relevant

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, create buy-in, and lead through complex global and cross-functional environments

• Strong knowledge of PMI-based project management practices. PMI/PMP certification is an advantage - other relevant certifications are also valued

• Experience with merger and acquisition projects

• A relevant master’s degree within life sciences, engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field

• Advanced expertise in Smartsheet combined with experience with Microsoft Project is an advantage

**Why join us?

**This role gives you the opportunity to influence both how strategic projects are delivered and how project management capability is built across Bavarian Nordic. You will combine high-impact project leadership with the chance to shape standards, develop colleagues, and create a lasting project excellence culture in a purpose-driven global vaccine organization.

If you are motivated by strategy and execution, enjoy building practical solutions, and feel energized by training and engaging others, we would love to hear from you.

**Caught your interest?

**Apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We do not offer any relocation packages for this role. Please note that employment is contingent on residing and working in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com

Would you like to take the lead in turning business opportunities into digital solutions that create measurable commercial impact?

As Digital Business Transformation Lead, you will help execute Hartmann’s European commercial strategy by identifying, shaping and delivering digital initiatives that improve customer experience and commercial efficiency. Reporting to the Commercial Excellence Director, Europe, you will work across markets and functions to turn business needs into practical solutions with measurable impact.

You will own the business side of agreed initiatives from discovery and concept development through implementation, adoption and benefits realisation. Group IT and technology partners will own architecture, cybersecurity and technical solution design.

Key responsibilities

• Identify and evaluate digital opportunities with customers and stakeholders across Hartmann’s European commercial organisation.

• Translate needs into customer journeys, future-state processes, concepts, prototypes and business requirements.

• Build business cases and support prioritisation of the European commercial digital portfolio.

• Lead the business side of agreed initiatives from discovery through implementation and adoption.

• Establish milestones, governance, risks, responsibilities and benefits tracking.

• Partner with Group IT and external providers while keeping customer needs and business outcomes central.

• Drive adoption through stakeholder engagement, communication, training and performance measurement.

Your experience and approach

You bring approximately 5–8 years of relevant experience in digital business transformation, product ownership, consulting or complex cross-functional delivery.

We expect you to have:

• Strong commercial and process understanding

• Experience taking unclear opportunities from discovery to implementation and adoption

• Ability to create structure, influence senior stakeholders and secure cross-functional commitment

• Working knowledge of digital platforms, data, automation and AI

• Strong English and sufficient Danish for informal workplace communication

Experience from manufacturing or an international B2B environment is valuable, but your ability to understand customers and turn business needs into practical improvements matters most.

You are curious, pragmatic and proactive. You create direction in ambiguous situations, test ideas quickly and remain hands-on until solutions are adopted and create value.

Hartmann offers

You will join an international company with more than 100 years of history and a strong position in the global food packaging industry.

The role offers:

• Ownership of visible European digital initiatives.

• Direct collaboration with customers, commercial leadership and Group IT.

• Freedom to test practical applications of digital solutions, automation and AI.

• An international role combining strategy, discovery and hands-on execution.

You will be responsible for translating Hartmann Europe’s commercial digital priorities into adopted solutions and measurable business improvements—not for defining enterprise technology strategy or owning technical architecture.

Location

The position is based at Hartmann’s headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark, with a flexible hybrid working arrangement. Expect approximately 10–20 travel days per year, primarily within Europe.

Contact and application

Hartmann is assisted in this recruitment process by European Search Company.

For more information, please contact Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638 or Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548.

Please submit your application using the apply button below. We review applications as they arrive and encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

About Hartmann Packaging

Founded in 1917, Hartmann is headquartered in Lyngby, Denmark. Hartmann is the world’s leading specialist in moulded fibre egg packaging and a trusted partner in the global food supply chain.

With more than 100 years of experience, we combine deep technology and manufacturing expertise with a strong global presence to design, produce, and deliver innovative moulded fibre products. In doing so, we provide sustainable packaging that helps feed the world – one carton at a time.

Hartmann employs approximately 2,800 employees across Europe, North America, South America, and APAC. Hartmann is part of the THORNICO Group

About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

• 
Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

• 
Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

• 
Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

• 
Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

• 
Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

• 
Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

• 
Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

• 
Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

• 
8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

• 
A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

• 
Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

• 
Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

• 
Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

• 
Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

• 
Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

• 
Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

• 
A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

• 
Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

• 
Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor (non-tenured) in archaeometry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A position as non-tenured Associate Professor in archaeometry is available from 1 May 2027 until 31 March 2030 at the Department of Physics Chemistry and Pharmacy, Faculty of Science, SDU in Odense.

About the research group and the project
The research group at which this position is posted is called CHART (Cultural Heritage and Archaeometric Research Team). Cultural Heritage and archaeometric research deal with investigations of samples originating from all sorts of culturally important artefacts: those procured by archaeologists in excavations, medieval buildings, handmade artefacts of all kinds, pieces of art, written materials. Only, the objects must have survived and be preserved today to some tangible degree. The study of cultural heritage is not exclusively for the humanities. In the last four or five decades, natural sciences have been increasingly involved in untangling the events of the past by studying cultural heritage objects to an ever-increasing degree of complexity. 

 

In CHART we take up the challenge of investigating cultural heritage objects on an international level using chemistry and physics. We aim at making a difference on the international scene by inventing new analytical methodologies, investigating objects of national and international interest, and by always securing collaboration between natural science and the humanities.

We do not claim to produce final or stand-alone answers; instead, we strive to achieve solutions together with colleagues from the humanities. In our research laboratories we daily cross the line between natural science and the humanities.

 

The present position is aimed at executing the already financed CIPP Center (Center for the Interior of Parchment and Paper), which involves the investigation of the Dead Sea Scrolls (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/fakulteterne/naturvidenskab/nyheder-2026/erc-dead-sea-scrolls-archaeometry), the development of new methods for analysing paper and parchment, and a new project on poisonous books conducted in collaboration with the Royal Academy in Copenhagen, Pisa University, and the Library at SDU (https://www.nature.com/articles/s40494-019-0334-2 ).   

 

About the candidate
The successful candidate is expected to hold a PhD in archaeometry, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field, with a research profile centred on the application of analytical and physical-chemical methods to archaeological and heritage materials. A demonstrated expertise in a wide range of archaeomaterials (e.g., ceramics, bricks, pigments, and parchments) spanning diverse chrono-cultural contexts will be considered an asset. 

 

Tasks

• 
The candidate must partake in the execution of the research at the CIPP Center conducted by the CHART research group and contribute to the overall research theme of CHART. 

• 
The candidate must be able to support the ongoing collaboration with ADBOU at the SDU Health Faculty.

• 
The candidate is expected to obtain external funding for independent research, to foster internal collaboration at the Department, and to build and lead an internationally recognized research group. 

• 
The candidate should contribute to public outreach and communication activities.

• 
The candidate should teach (broadly) in degree programmes at the department, as well as participate in departmental administration, strategy development and educational programme development. 

• 
The candidate is expected to mentor undergraduate, graduate, and research students. 

 

Skills

• 
The candidate must have a strong and independent research profile, documented by an excellent track record of peer-reviewed publications in international journals. Hands-on experience with advanced analytical chemical instrumentation, experience with luminescence-based dating methods, and a demonstrated ability to develop or adapt analytical chemical methods will be highly valued.

• 
Experience with international collaboration, of partnerships with museums and cultural-heritage institutions, and of collaboration with the private sector will be an advantage.

• 
The successful candidate should have a strong teaching record. This includes experience with teaching courses within a chemistry curriculum at bachelor and master level as well as experience of project supervision across all levels, from bachelor to PhD. Experience with interdisciplinary, practical, and laboratory-based teaching, and with modern teaching methods, e-learning, flipped classroom, and online learning methods will be an advantage. A teaching CV should be included in the proposal. Teaching at the department includes first year teaching held in Danish, and the successful applicant may be expected to be involved in first year teaching. However, teaching in English is accepted from the start of employment, and the successful applicant is expected to learn basic Danish within 5 years. The university offers language courses.

The candidate will be part of the chemistry section. 

Application deadline: 15. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

Facilitate great global service

At BEUMER Group, we deliver intralogistics solutions such as mission critical baggage handling systems for airports and parcel handling systems for a variety of logistic customers all over the world. We have the leading product on the market, and the office in Aarhus is an international Centre of Competence. From here, you support 29 Beumer Group Companies around the world and help carry the strategic responsibility for our global service contracts.

Support colleagues and customers globally

Working with our colleagues in 29 Group Companies around the world, you will support Operation & Maintenance solutions for their regions by driving quotations and price calculations and defining the right winning strategy. You will also support a pool of over 100 existing O&M contracts worldwide. Although most of your interactions will be internal, at times you will also be working closely with our customers, via online or physical meetings and presentations. The role, however, is quite broad and dynamic, with the main responsibilities listed below:

• Analysing customer requirements in tender documents from a commercial, operational and organizational perspective to establish the right O&M service solutions

• Identifying, analysing and mitigating risks of new opportunities and existing contracts

• Close cooperation with project teams, sales teams and all departments within the organization

• Monitoring existing contracts so as to verify that they are performing well and adhering to the global O&M processes and company strategy

• Acting as single point of contact for all O&M contracts and Group Companies as well as facilitating work in all O&M contracts while promoting know-how sharing and best practice across O&M sites globally

• Overall planning on the implementation of new service contracts, including the resources, time and commercial aspects as well as the coordination with the customer and Group Companies

• As custodians of our global O&M processes and tools, constantly reviewing and enforcing them

• Following up on the implementation and the continuous optimisation of the service concepts

People person with experience managing and quoting maintenance solutions

Responsibility, communication and collaboration. These are three skills that are essential in this outgoing role, where you act across sites and cultures. You need to be able to talk to everyone – from service technicians to CEOs – communicating convincingly and persuasively. With no direct reports, your internal networking is highly important in this role as there is constant interaction with internal departments. At the end of the day, we are looking for your clout, energy and motivation to participate in global teamwork and collaborations. The requirements for the role are:

• A commercial background in a relevant technical field or a technical background from a similar industry. Experience with managing and quoting maintenance solutions is a strong advantage but not a must.

• A great communicator, fluent in English -spoken and in written-, who can talk and challenge people at all levels of the organisation

• Excellent skills in MS Office, especially Excel.

We offer you the opportunity to become part of a family-owned global industry leader, where quality in everything we do is essential for us. We are extremely customer-driven and team-oriented, and we are only successful, when everybody participates and help each other out. Our O&M-contracts are crucial for not just our business, but also for the many airports and logistics sites we support all over the world and by joining us a our new Operations & Maintenance Sales & Service Manager, you will not just help our company and customers, but also help making sure that parcels and baggage arrive quickly and in the right hands every time.

Interested?

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Talent Acquisition Lead, Søren Elkjær Holm, on : +45 3176 0448.

We look forward to meeting you!

BEUMER Group

jobs.description:
Are you a skilled planner with an eye for both the big picture and the finer details, and are you passionate about an exciting everyday life in an international IT company? Then you could be our new Personal Assistant to our Partner Group at our Copenhagen office.

Responsibilities

Your primary responsibility will be to act as the central point of contact, orchestrating the day-to-day activities of the Partner Group through effective calendar management, document management and archiving, travel planning and booking, as well as thorough meeting preparation. Your role is to ensure that the partners can operate professionally, in a coordinated and efficient manner, while working behind the scenes to involve the right stakeholders and ensure progress.

Your proactive approach will enable the partners to focus on strategic decisions while you handle the practical and administrative aspects. Therefore, the ability to anticipate needs, identify challenges, and initiate solutions is essential.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Efficient management of the Partner Group’s calendars, including prioritising and optimising their time, as well as coordinating and booking travel arrangements.

• Thorough preparation of meeting materials, gathering relevant information, taking accurate meeting minutes, and following up on action items to ensure progress.

• Flexible handling of ad hoc tasks to support the Partner Group’s day-to-day activities and strategic objectives.

About you

To succeed in this role, you thrive in a dynamic environment with many different stakeholders and points of contact. At Netcompany, we set the bar high, and we are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented individual. You should be self-motivated and enjoy both proactive planning and effective problem-solving. In addition, you understand the importance of handling confidential information with loyalty and discretion. A strong understanding of the business and excellent communication skills is also essential.

We imagine that you:

• Have several years of experience as a Personal Assistant or in a similar coordinating role.

• Thrive on handling administrative and practical tasks at a high level.

• Work in a structured manner and have an exceptional ability to create and maintain an overview.

• Have strong technical skills, particularly in Microsoft Office, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

We expect a high level of commitment and a dedicated and proactive approach to your responsibilities. Your ability to take initiative and contribute new ideas and solutions will be highly valued. At Netcompany, we place great emphasis on both your professional and personal development, and you will naturally receive support and guidance from your colleagues in the PA team.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

Job Description

Join BEUMER Group Innovation & Development in creating solutions that power the next level of logistic sortation systems worldwide. As a Robotics Software Engineer at BEUMER Group, you’ll design innovative solutions that drive efficiency and reliability in sortation and handling systems for logistic sites around the globe.

Our logistics customers seek innovative solutions to improve the efficiency of their sites. This includes automating manual processes through technologies such as mobile carrier robots, articulated robots, and computer vision software. More broadly, digitalization is a key driver of efficiency improvements.

To meet these needs, we are intensifying our focus on innovation and investing more in bringing new products to the market to address our customers’ evolving needs, making this an exciting time to join BEUMER Group.

Global innovation team

As our new Robotics Software Engineer, you will join a local, cross-functional Innovation & Development team consisting of highly skilled professionals in computer vision, robotics, user experience design, software architecture, and software development. The team operates in a global setup and collaborates closely with colleagues across locations and disciplines. The team's mission is to develop innovative products and systems for the logistics industry.

In your role as Robotics Software Engineer, you will:

• Develop, maintain, and debug software on industrial PCs and robotic platforms, including communication and computer vision applications.

• Configure, program, and integrate industrial robots and motion control systems.

• Work with geometric and spatial calculations related to robot motion, object positioning, and vision-guided applications.

• Participate in the development of new products, from early prototypes to market-ready solutions.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across disciplines and locations in a global organization.

Driving business value

You have a strong background in designing and implementing automation solutions across a range of software platforms. You are innovative, proactive, and capable of developing automation systems and software that enhance efficiency and create business value.

You bring the following qualifications to the role:

• A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field.

• Experience with robotics and automation technologies, preferably from a similar or related industry.

• Experience developing near real-time software and solid knowledge of C#. Experience with Python, Docker, and microservice architecture is an advantage.

• Interest in robotics software and technologies, particularly in combination with computer vision applications.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment.

• Strong understanding of geometry and spatial reasoning, including the ability to model and calculate physical dimensions, positions, and movements in real-world systems.

jobs.occupation: Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura
jobs.description:
Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura

Do you know municipal case management in social services inside out – VUM, FFB, service catalogues, rates and citizens' co-payments – and would you like to help municipalities get the most out of their IT support for social services? Then seize this unique opportunity to put your professional insight to use in a company with high ambitions, and help our customers get the greatest value from Columna Cura!

Join a collaborative and ambitious team

As our new Implementation Consultant, you'll work with Columna Cura, our IT solution for the health and social care sector, which supports staff, citizens and relatives throughout the citizen's entire care journey. The solution is already live in 38 Danish municipalities, and we're growing in social services, where case management, service provision and collaboration between authority and provider place specific demands on how the system is configured and used.

You'll join the Cura Projects & Services team, made up of dedicated colleagues – consultants, solution architects, service developers and more.

The team's main responsibility is project and service delivery, and your tasks will include implementation projects, training and professional guidance on configuration.

Play a key role and contribute to Systematic's growth

As our new Implementation Consultant on Columna Cura, you'll play a key role in helping municipalities get off to a strong start with Cura in social services – and continue to get optimal value from the Cura product suite afterwards. You'll bridge the gap between the municipality's case management practices, providers' needs and the system's setup, translating assessments, service catalogues, rates and workflows between authority and provider into a well-functioning Cura setup.

Your insights from customer dialogue also feed into our product and service development.

Your key tasks will include:

• advising municipalities on how to configure Cura to support case management in social services, including VUM (the Adult Needs Assessment Method) and the process from assessment and decision to service delivery

• setting up and maintaining service catalogues (FFB – Denmark's Common Professional Concepts framework – and municipal services), rates and rules for citizens' co-payments in collaboration with the customer

• supporting collaboration between case workers and internal and external providers in Cura, including ordering, follow-up and billing of services

• training system administrators and super users to use and configure Cura

• producing and maintaining functional documentation that helps customers configure Cura to their needs

• taking part in tender responses for new customers

• working closely with your colleagues in Cura Projects & Services, Product Management and Domain Advisors, and feeding valuable customer insights from social services into our product development

You should expect around five travel days a month to customers in Denmark and Norway.

Put your social services expertise to use

Our new colleague knows social services inside out – either as a social worker with hands-on experience in case management or with providers, or as a system administrator or super user of Columna Cura or a similar IT solution for social services. You're a strong communicator who's motivated by helping others and committed to laying the groundwork for customer success and satisfaction.

We expect you to have in-depth knowledge of municipal case management in social services – particularly the VUM method, FFB and service catalogues, services, rates, citizens' co-payments, and collaboration with internal and external providers. Experience with Columna Cura or a similar specialist system for social services is a strong advantage, but the right professional insight matters more to us than the exact system you know.

It would be a huge plus if you also know the provider side of social services – for example residential care, supported housing, and activity and employment services – and understand how orders, goals, documentation and follow-up move between authority and provider. That understanding is exactly what enables you to help a municipality set up Cura so that case workers and providers work as one connected process.

We also imagine that you:

• can translate legislation and case management practice into concrete system setup and clear guidance for users

• enjoy coordinating and collaborating with customers and stakeholders – from case workers and providers to system owners and management

are proactive and take the initiative

• speak and write Danish and English fluently - Non Danish Speakers need not apply

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO/EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 social/professional events a year. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, games tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is truly international, proudly Danish and uniquely people-centric. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

You can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers almost 100 events of both social and professional character a year, so there is plenty to choose from. Our colleagues also highlight our canteen, which serves a variety of delicious and healthy dishes each day. In addition, we offer several employee benefits such as paid Home Internet, health insurance and a company pension scheme. Finally, we are always up for a friendly game of padel at our new padel court in Aarhus!

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Mette Skylvad, Program Manager.
